metadata.title: fix: resolve duplicate settings import and update VALIDATION_MAX_JSON_DEPTH default
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

Based on #1868 by @BearingNode - consolidated and extended with additional fixes.

- Remove duplicate import in `mcpgateway/common/validators.py` (was importing from both `common/config.py` and `config.py`)
- Delete unused `mcpgateway/common/config.py` (dead code with 0 imports anywhere in codebase)
- Update `VALIDATION_MAX_JSON_DEPTH` default from 10 to 30 across all documentation:
  - Helm charts (`values.yaml`, `README.md`)
  - Config schema JSON files
  - `CHANGELOG.md`
  - Code docstrings and comments
- Fix test patch targets to use correct import path (`mcpgateway.common.validators.settings`)
- Update test payloads to exceed new depth limit of 30
- Remove `--cov` from pytest defaults (CI sets coverage flags explicitly)

Closes #1868

Co-authored-by: roller100 <contact@bearingnode.com>

commits.message:

- Delete unused mcpgateway/common/config.py (dead code with 0 imports)
- Update VALIDATION_MAX_JSON_DEPTH default from 10 to 30 in all docs:

  - Config schema JSON files
  - CHANGELOG.md
  - Code docstrings and comments
- Fix test patch targets to use correct import path
  (mcpgateway.common.validators.settings, not mcpgateway.config.settings)
- Update test payloads to exceed new depth limit of 30
- Remove --cov from pytest defaults (CI sets it explicitly)
